assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: contextual illustration for Australian Year 4 science topic pages. Create a polished realistic textbook watercolour and coloured-pencil illustration on a clean white background, landscape 3:2. A small Australian garden habitat: green grass and a leafy native shrub, one green caterpillar resting on a leaf, one small superb fairy-wren perched on a low branch, fallen brown leaves with a few small fungi near damp soil. Show natural plant, animal and decomposing-leaf details clearly, with gentle daylight, restrained natural colours and blue accents, crisp enough for a school science book. This is a habitat scene for discussion, not a diagram of measured quantities. No labels, no text, no numbers, no arrows, no logos, no border, no fantasy anatomy, no floating organisms, no food-chain arrows. Calm, accurate, uncluttered, age 9–10.
assets.role: Habitat context; exact feeding-role evidence is supplied in the lesson records.

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: contextual illustration for Australian Year 4 science investigations. Create a polished realistic textbook watercolour and coloured-pencil illustration on a clean white background, landscape 3:2. A tidy school science workbench with a small rectangular wooden sliding block with cotton pulling cord attached, a smooth wooden test board beside a strip of textured felt, a large classroom horseshoe magnet resting safely aside, rounded swatches of cotton fabric, rubber and nylon, a short aluminium strip, a clear unmarked plastic measuring jug and a blank notebook. An adult hand gently holds the pulling cord; no children or faces. Gentle daylight, blue and natural wood tones, crisp scientific-book detail consistent with realistic watercolour textbook illustration. Objects are contextual props; do not show exact measurements or pretend a force reading. No labels, no legible text, no numbers, no arrows, no measurement markings, no logos, no glass shards, no tiny loose magnets, no dangerous tools. Uncluttered, age 9–10.
assets.role: Materials and investigation context; no measurements are read from the artwork.
